reviews.text: There are way too many ads. I get you have to have ads for some sort of paying thing but that doesn’t mean every time you click something it has to be an ad. I want to just play the game. The actual game itself is pretty fun but the ads ruin it so instead of solving puzzles you are just watching ads. Also the ranking of hard and easy is not accurate. For comparisons a hard question is as easy  as 2 plus 2. But an easy question is like 6444 squared then divided by the gcf and a whole lot of complicated stuff. Also give more coins! I was on a hard level and I had coins but as soon as I yawed like one thing I was broke. Or if you don’t want to give out as much coins, in the gifts give out more items.

reviews.text: The puzzles are basic and easy, and even the “hard” ones are simple. reviews.title: Too many ads
reviews.text:
Don’t even download this game unless you’re going to pay to remove the ads. It’s virtually unplayable otherwise. Every click you make results in a new ad. Accidentally click on the menu button? Too bad- here’s a 30 second ad for you. And, when that’s over and you think you can get back to the game, you find that now the level has to ‘load’ which is simply an opportunity for them to show you another ad. Two for the price of one! 

I get putting in ads to make money and encourage people to buy the game, but this is genuinely ridiculous. Who shows two ads in a row? Seeing it was only $3, I figured it was worth trying. Unfortunately, this game isn’t unique enough nor is the interface good enough to justify buying it, let alone the fact that the ads don’t completely disappear after paying. Compared to other games I’ve purchased that left me alone after getting my money, this one is persistently terrible. Wouldn’t recommend
